newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah stabilises after baht jolt.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah stabilises after baht jolt.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah stabilised against the dollar after a brief jolt on the floatation of the Thai baht in early trading on Wednesday, dealers said.
They said the market had cooled down by mid-morning, with spot rates hovering at around 2,434.0/35.0 at 0245 GMT against an opening 2,432.5/33.5.
The rupiah fell to a low of 2,445.0 before the floatation announcement on fears that the Thai government might announce a currency devaluation.
Dealers said the announcement helped the market regain confidence and sent the rupiah back to its opening level.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,433.75/34.25 and 2,433.5/34.0, respectively.
Dealers said liquidity appeared to be sufficient, with overnight rates traded at 11.0/12.0 percent.
Thailand's Finance Minister Thanong Bidaya said on Wednesday that the value of the baht would be set by market forces effective immediately.

One economist at a state bank said Indonesia's economic fundamentals were better than Thailand and the dollar-rupiah rate has a eight-percent central bank intervention band which should help absorb market volatility.
